description: This Java class defines a Fragment that displays a camera preview in an Android application, handling camera access, permission checks, and UI setup.

classes.name: CameraPreviewFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages camera preview display, including camera initialization, permission handling, and resource release.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of CameraPreviewFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes camera, and sets up the camera preview or error message if camera is unavailable.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera resource when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: getCameraInstance
methods.description: Safely attempts to open and return a Camera object for the specified camera ID.

methods.name: releaseCamera
methods.description: Releases the camera resource if it is currently held.
